head: 9531759ac
deviation: The plan put Focus and Attach in a rail inside the dock container, with the resize handle. The code shows a separate rail with a fixed width of 96 px (w-24) in place of the dock. The rail has the label "Git window" and two text buttons, Focus and Attach, at the top. The remaining height of the rail is empty. The Git tab at the right edge stays and focuses the Git window. No second dock mounts. Effect for the user: the main window gets back the dock width minus 96 px, the rail cannot be resized or collapsed, and it uses 96 px for two small buttons. Decide: accept the 96 px rail as it is, or ask for a narrower rail (or for the two actions in the Git tab strip) as a follow-up.

defects.title: 1. Git window had no surface of its own
defects.detail: The Git window now uses the surface of the docked dock (electron-git-dock, data-glass-surface="chrome"). It fills the window height. The header row is on the surface. The empty and loading states are in the center of the surface. No new surface or token.

defects.title: 2. Git window did not follow a theme change
defects.detail: The main window publishes its theme name with the Git scope. The open Git window applies it at run time and persists nothing. Limit: the Git window follows the theme name only. It does not follow a change of accent or scene.
defects.where: Frame "Theme followed at run time" in group 2.

defects.title: 3. Detached rail: 96 px column with two text buttons
defects.detail: Focus and Attach are ghost buttons with no icon and no border, so they look like labels. The rail is empty below them for the full height. This is the decision 16 deviation. Not changed.

defects.title: 4. Detach button stood alone in the no-repository state
defects.detail: With no repository the dock header is empty. The dock now shows Detach and its divider only when the folder is a repository. Effect: you cannot detach the dock in a folder that is not a repository.
defects.where: Frame "Folder that is not a repository, docked".

defects.title: 5. Detach and Attach had no icon
defects.detail: Detach has the picture-in-picture icon and a divider that separates it from Pull and Push. Attach in the Git window has the panel icon. The accessible names are unchanged ("Detach", "Attach"). The Attach button of the 96 px rail is not changed (defect 3).

defects.title: 6. Content was clipped at the default width of the Git window
defects.detail: The default width is 920 px (before: 620 px) and the minimum width is 720 px (before: 420 px). A saved user size is kept. A saved width below the minimum goes up to 720 px.
defects.where: Frames "default width" and "minimum width" in group 2.

defects.title: 7. Focus ring color is different in the two themes
defects.detail: Detach, Focus and Attach are btn btn-ghost btn-xs buttons, the same classes as Pull and Push in the docked dock. No button has a focus rule of its own. The ring comes from one global rule: outline 2px solid var(--glass-focus), offset 2px, and in dark glass mode a halo of oklch(var(--b1) / 0.9). The tokens match the docked dock. --glass-focus has a different value in each theme, which gives white and gold.

defects.title: 8. Raw Git error text in the error state (not from this PR)
defects.detail: A failed Pull shows the full Git message in four lines of red text, with the branch name on a line of its own. The dock shows the same text when it is docked.

notCaptured.title: Session switch (follow session)
notCaptured.detail: The Git window follows the active session. The capture runs on a new, empty home folder with one workspace and no session, so no second session scope exists to switch to.

notCaptured.title: Error states of the window life cycle
notCaptured.detail: The rail error text (failed open, focus or attach) and the Git window "Could not load the Git scope." alert with Retry need a failed RPC. The capture uses real RPC handlers only, and these calls did not fail.

notCaptured.title: Light first paint of the Git window
notCaptured.detail: The "Resolving Git scope…" frame is captured in the dark theme only.

notCaptured.title: No repository, detached
notCaptured.detail: With no repository the dock shows no Detach button (defect 4 fix), so this state has no detached frame.
